newsitem.title: USA: Plexus sees Q3 EPS meeting or beating Q2.
newsitem.headline: Plexus sees Q3 EPS meeting or beating Q2.

text.p: Plexus Corp said Wednesday it currently expects earnings for its fiscal third quarter ending June 30 will equal or exceed the $0.47 per fully diluted share reported for its fiscal second quarter.
"While the quarter is obviously not complete, the positive trends over recent quarters continued into the third quarter," Plexus chief financial officer Thomas Sabol said in a statement.
The company, which provides design, manufacturing and testing services to the electronics industry, said it expects to announce earnings on or about July 17.
